description: This file defines the ClusterMembershipOptions class, which contains configuration settings for cluster membership management in Orleans, including liveness protocols, heartbeat intervals, and cluster cleanup parameters.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for managing cluster membership and liveness protocols in Orleans.

methods.name: AllowedIAmAliveMissPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the period after which a silo is ignored for initial connectivity validation based on missed heartbeats.

methods.name: ClusteringShutdownGracePeriod
methods.description: Defines the grace period to wait during shutdown for the cluster membership system to terminate.
